The **Eiffel Tower** (#1 on most Paris bucket lists) is one of the most iconic landmarks in the world—and for good reason! Here’s why it’s so special:

### **1. Engineering Marvel & Historical Significance**
- Built in **1889** for the **World’s Fair** (Exposition Universelle), it was originally meant to be temporary (and many Parisians hated it at first!).
- Designed by **Gustave Eiffel**, it was the **tallest man-made structure in the world** (324m / 1,063 ft) until the Chrysler Building in NYC surpassed it in 1930.
